text:
sara_sales: Heads-up: MarinerBio pushed timeline — wants pilot in production next Friday COB. They listed 3 hard blockers: BYO HSM/KMS handshake, VPC peering signoff, and a strict monthly spend cap from procurement. Need a 20-30m exec bridge today to align.
alan_se: ok. Who owns the KMS integration validation? I can drive a checklist but need the vendor + cert details.
maria_eng: We ran a lab for Cloud KMS variants. For an on-prem HSM (their case) we'll need a PKI cert exchange + change to key-wrap flow. Ballpark: 48-72h eng work + 1-day ops validation.
sara_sales: Their security team named the HSM vendor ThaliosSec and asked for attestation + diagrams. Carmen, status on the security questionnaire?
carmen_cso: Q completed except for HSM attestation and log retention term. Procurement wants 13 months retention. We're waiting for their legal to deliver the signed attestation doc. If they can't, we can issue a pilot-scoped attestation addendum (legal ok, needs exec approval).
rachel_csm: I've scheduled a 30m sync with their CTO today 3pm PT to cover network topology and compliance. Invited Eng + Security + Finance.
vince_re: Procurement demands: hard monthly cap and an auto-failover to a cheaper model if cap exceeded. Sales needs approval to offer a capped invoice + reserved discount option. Tom, what discount range can finance sign off for 12-mo committed?
tom_finance: For committed reserved (12m) discounts: typical band 15-20% depending on GPU class and committed RU. We can stretch to 22% with approval from ops head. Also can approve a temporary POC credit to smooth early spend.
alan_se: Technical detail for the call: do they require private interface (no internet egress) or ok with peering/NAT? This affects whether we need to deploy private endpoints and warm capacity.
maria_eng: If private endpoints required -> need ~24h to pre-warm dedicated node pool in their region. If peering/NAT we can use standard peering and proxy for KMS. For ThaliosSec, offline key import support is unclear; if they insist on offline import that's extra work.
sara_sales: Action list for the exec bridge: 1) Maria to confirm feasibility and time estimate for Thalios handshake (owner: maria_eng) 2) Carmen to request signed attestation PDF from MarinerBio legal (owner: carmen_cso) 3) Tom to confirm discount ceiling and POC credit option (owner: tom_finance) 4) Rachel to run the exec call and secure topology diagram (owner: rachel_csm)
devops-bot: Reference: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/poc-byo-kms step-3 has the cert exchange template. Also VPC peering checklist: runbook/vpc-peering-checklist.
carmen_cso: If we don't get the Thalios attestation, legal says: allow pilot under an addendum tied to our SOC2 plus targeted attestation clause; exec sign-off required.
vince_re: I'll draft two offers to present on the bridge: Option 1 = Monthly capped plan with alerting + automatic fallback to a lower-cost open model on breach. Option 2 = 12-month reserved with X% discount and capacity SLA. Present both, highlight rollback safety.
alan_se: Quick note: for the KMS handshake we need sample certs and preferred cipher suites. Can MarinerBio share their CA chain and allowed ciphers before call?
rachel_csm: Asked them in the invite to upload topology + CA chain to the shared drive before the call. Also requested an architecture diagram of their HSM setup.
maria_eng: I'll start a validation ticket immediately. If offline import is required we propose a KMS-proxy pattern for the pilot (faster) and full handshake for GA.
sara_sales: Bridge set for today 3pm PT. Please join 10 minutes early if you're leading a block. Update the internal ticket with any changes before 2:45pm PT. :thumbsup:
